scientific_question: Among otherwise comparable Azorean island arthropod source-loss events with exactly one occupied source lost from BALA1 to BALA2, does the fraction of a surviving target population's pre-loss source access carried by that lost source predict subsequent BALA2-to-BALA3 contraction?

analysis_population.taxonomic_rule: exactly the frozen v1.137 rule: exclude Diptera, non-Formicidae Hymenoptera, Acari/Collembola and taxonomy-conflict taxa
analysis_population.source_loss_event: exactly one BALA1 occupied island is absent in BALA2
analysis_population.target_row: a different island occupied in BALA2 for the same eligible taxon

source_operator.graph: exact frozen seven-island Gabriel graph from development/bala_geometry_operator_contract_v1_136.json
source_operator.self_anchor_exclusion: for target island i, remove i from every source set before source count, distance, pressure or leverage is computed

primary_exposure.name: target_specific_lost_access_fraction_E_i
primary_exposure.baseline_sources: S0_minus_i = BALA1 occupied islands excluding target i
primary_exposure.lost_sources: L01_minus_i = members of S0_minus_i absent in BALA2; exactly one globally under the primary event rule
primary_exposure.denominator: P_i = sum K_is over s in S0_minus_i
primary_exposure.numerator: sum K_is over s in L01_minus_i
primary_exposure.domain: 0 < E_i <= 1 under eligible exactly-one-loss target rows

secondary_exposure.name: event_level_effective_source_number_decrement
secondary_exposure.source_pressure_mass_A_s: sum K_is over all seven frozen island geometry targets i != s
secondary_exposure.source_share_q_s: A_s / sum A_r over BALA1 occupied sources r
secondary_exposure.N_eff_after: same quantity after deleting the actually lost BALA1 source
secondary_exposure.role: secondary descriptive direction only; cannot rescue primary

reference_R2.static_island_control: six dummy variables plus intercept for the seven island codes with alphabetically first code as reference; this intentionally absorbs all time-invariant island area, external isolation, habitat and generic-network differences
continuous_predictors: other-source count at BALA1 after self-anchor exclusion
surviving-other-source count at BALA2 after self-anchor exclusion
nearest surviving-other-source Euclidean distance in km
diffuse surviving-other-source Euclidean pressure using exp(-distance/78.93702465087111)
log1p BALA3 recovered pitfall positions for target island from response-independent Event metadata

no_surviving_other_source_rule.nearest_distance_value: D_sentinel = maximum pairwise haversine distance among the seven frozen islands + 78.93702465087111 km

reference_R2.exactly_one_loss_count_control: held fixed by the primary event restriction rather than entered as a zero-variance predictor
reference_R2.bioregion_archipelago: constant Azores system; no separate coefficient
reference_R2.generic_graph_metrics: not separately entered because the complete island fixed effects absorb every time-invariant seven-island generic graph property

feature_standardization.continuous_R2_and_E_i: within each leave-one-taxon-out fold, mean and population SD from training target rows only
feature_standardization.zero_variance_training_predictor: drop that predictor identically from R2 and C for that fold; E_i zero variance makes that fold non-estimable

validation.nonestimable_fold: retained in accounting but contributes no effect value

t2_endpoint.analysis_row: target taxon-island population present at BALA2
t2_endpoint.outcome_1: contraction: target absent from all eligible BALA3 pitfall events
t2_endpoint.outcome_0: persistence: at least one positive BALA3 pitfall occurrence
t2_endpoint.surveyed_zero_allowed: only because every frozen island-phase passes the v1.135 pitfall surveyed-zero quality gate

primary.estimand: equal-weight mean across estimable heldout MF taxa of within-taxon mean [binary logloss(C,y)-binary logloss(R2,y)]
primary.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and taxon-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0

directional_secondary.estimand: coefficient/sign and descriptive contraction frequency gradient for continuous E_i under the frozen candidate model
directional_secondary.predicted_direction: higher E_i predicts greater contraction probability

pre_t2_gate.if_failed: STOP before BALA3 semantic access; do not relax thresholds

confirmatory_stage_order: v1.138 split exact confirmatory bytes into BALA1/2 and sealed BALA3 without ecological semantics
open only BALA1/2 and apply the unchanged taxonomic/presence rules
freeze eligible confirmatory taxa, exactly-one-loss events, target rows, E_i, secondary delta_N_eff, complete R2/C feature matrix and leave-one-taxon-out folds
verify the pre-t2 gate and freeze exact feature/fold fingerprints
only then authorize one BALA3 semantic read for eligible taxa/target islands
fit and score the frozen leave-one-taxon-out R2/C models once
freeze terminal result; no same-lineage rerun

claim_boundary.if_primary_supported: pre-loss source-access leverage predicts future observed occupancy contraction beyond source count, ordinary remaining-source geometry, island identity and survey effort in the BALA system

anti_selection: do not use pilot leverage-outcome association to choose the confirmatory operator
do not change exactly-one-loss restriction after BALA1/2 confirmatory access
do not tune lambda, graph structure, E_i formula or ridge strength on BALA3 outcomes
do not drop taxa or islands because their t2 direction is inconvenient
do not replace taxon-macro primary with row-weighted scoring after t2 access
do not use secondary delta_N_eff or subgroup results to rescue a failed primary
